$comment: The field vocabulary an app's endpoint parameters and returns are written against. Generated by backend/scripts/export_param_vocabulary.py from app/services/graph/bindings/specs.py — the same constants this service's reader and the editor's renderer are built from. Do not edit by hand.

source.$comment: Where a field's choices come from when they are not a fixed list: a read endpoint of the same app, plus which of its list returns carry the values and which carry the labels. A source param is fed either from a sibling field ('from') or from a literal ('value'), never both.

identity.$comment: Which of an endpoint's returns identify the thing it touched. A write and an emission declaring the same kind and key produce the same address, which is what lets a change an automation made be kept from firing it again. Every part must be a single value rather than a list.

filterable_returns.$comment: An emit endpoint carries no parameters — nobody calls it — so a subscription is narrowed on what the emission DECLARES it carries. A return marked filterable becomes an optional control on the trigger, and the match happens at enqueue rather than in a condition after the fire.
